current_norm_authority.source: Правила русской орфографии и пунктуации. Полный академический справочник / под ред. В. В. Лопатина
current_norm_authority.section: Правила употребления прописных и строчных букв; аббревиатуры и производные от них слова
current_norm_authority.normalization_note: Current academic organization groups several historically separate Rosenthal paragraphs into broader modern systems: personal names with derivatives; geographic/administrative names with derivatives; trademarks/brands/varieties; special stylistic capitalization; abbreviations. The denominator follows learner decisions, not the old paragraph count.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Прописная буква в начале текста и после знака, завершающего предложение
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: General capitalization rule; distinguish a genuinely new sentence/text from punctuation that does not start a new independent sentence.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Имена людей, клички животных, мифологические имена и производные от индивидуальных названий
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: One structured family with branches for personal names/pseudonyms/nicknames/animal names/mythological names and for derivatives whose capitalization depends on whether individual-name status is preserved or lexicalized/noun-like meaning has developed.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Географические и административно-территориальные названия и производные от них слова
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Determine which components belong to the individual geographic/administrative name and which are generic terms; handle derivatives by current proper-name status rather than a blanket all-words-capital rule.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Астрономические названия: собственное имя или нарицательное/обычное употребление
Органы власти, учреждения, организации, общества, партии, предприятия: прописные по структуре официального названия
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Do not capitalize every content word mechanically; identify the official name, its first component, embedded proper names, conventional abbreviations and generic uses according to the current academic model.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Исторические эпохи и события, календарные периоды, праздники и общественные мероприятия
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: One modern family because current academic rules treat historical events together with calendar/holiday/public-event names; dictionary/official-name status controls edge cases.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Документы, памятники, предметы, произведения искусства, издания и информационные названия
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: This unit owns capitalization inside the name. Quotation-mark placement is a separate punctuation/orthographic formatting decision and will be owned by P28/P29 families; do not double-count.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Должности, звания и титулы: прописная или строчная по статусу и контексту
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Separate conventional official/high-title capitalization from ordinary generic job/title usage; avoid treating social importance alone as a rule.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Ордена, медали, награды, знаки отличия и премии: оформление компонентов названия
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Quotation marks, when required in individual award names, are formatting branches outside the capitalization count.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Названия, связанные с религией: имена, священные тексты, праздники, учреждения и употребления
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Use the current academic religious-name system rather than reproducing Soviet-era editorial simplifications from an older source edition.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Товарные знаки, марки изделий, породы, виды и сорта: собственное название или нарицательное обозначение
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: The modern academic section groups trademarks, product brands and varieties. The learner decision is proper/brand/variety-name status versus lexicalized generic use; individual product categories are branches, not separate denominator units.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Аббревиатуры и сложносокращённые слова: прописные/строчные, звуковое чтение и производные формы
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Letter abbreviations are normally uppercase; sound abbreviations and lexicalized forms have current conventional patterns; inflectional endings and suffixal derivatives follow the current academic rules rather than a mechanical uppercase transfer.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Условные и особые стилистические прописные: официальное или экспрессивное употребление
canonical_units.current_norm_scope: Owns conventional official-document names such as role designations when used as contractual conventional names and special stylistic capitalization such as Родина/Отчизна in the sanctioned expressive use. This is context/style controlled, not a universal lexical uppercase rule.

count_assertion.warning: 172 is not final. Waves B-G remain unresolved; later parent/branch dedupe can change the semantic total.
